metadata.title: Infrastructure reliability incident investigation
metadata.artifact_scope_note: Evidence is aggregated query output (not raw log lines or metric samples); it contains no chat/communication records.

incident_description: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Pixelfold (photo sharing); Platform: Microsoft Azure West Europe; Kubernetes cluster: pf-weu-prod (AKS, node range 10.224.0.0/16); Object storage: Azure Blob Storage account holding originals and thumbnails; CDN in front of gallery-web; Deployments: Azure Pipelines releases with REL- identifiers; manual changes use CHG- identifiers.
investigation_questions: Which external storage endpoint returned the errors?
What is the cloud provider's tracking ID for the service event?
During what hour did the first signs of the failure appear? Provide the earliest date and time in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM UTC format.

What is the root cause category of the incident: configuration change, software defect, hardware failure, cloud provider failure, capacity exhaustion, automation error, certificate expiry, or third-party dependency failure?
Which of the three CIA components is primarily affected: availability, integrity, or confidentiality?
According to the error volume statistics, what single service emitted the most errors? Is it the root cause or a downstream symptom?
Which deployment preceded the errors but did not cause them? Provide its identifier.
Did rolling back thumbnail-worker restore normal service? Answer yes or no.
